privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy – Pujo Pandal, Siliguri Durga Puja Guide
privacy-policy.description: How Pujo Pandal (durgapujapandal.site) handles your data: no accounts, saved pandals stay on your device, location is used only in your browser.
privacy-policy.intro: Pujo Pandal (durgapujapandal.site) is a free guide to Durga Puja in Siliguri. We built it to collect as little about you as possible. This policy explains what happens to your information when you use the site.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: You do not need an account to use Pujo Pandal, and we do not ask for your name, phone number or email to browse the site.

If you email us — directly or through the contact form, which opens your own email app — we receive whatever you choose to write, along with your email address. We use it only to reply and to update pandal information.

sections.heading: Saved pandals stay on your device
paragraphs: Pandals you save to “My Puja plan” are stored in your browser’s local storage on your own device. They are never sent to us. Clearing your browser data removes them.

sections.heading: Your location
paragraphs: When you tap “Near Me” or “Use my location”, your browser asks for permission. If you allow it, your position is used inside your browser to centre the map and build routes. We do not store or receive it.
When you build a route, the coordinates of the start point and the pandals are sent to the OpenStreetMap routing service (routing.openstreetmap.de) to draw the road path on the map.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: Maps are drawn with map tiles from Google Maps and OpenStreetMap. Like any website, those services receive your IP address and browser details when your device loads their images. “Open in Google Maps” and “Directions” links take you to Google Maps, where Google’s privacy policy applies.
The site is hosted on Vercel, which keeps standard server logs (IP address, browser, pages requested and time) for security and reliability.
We do not run advertising or analytics trackers. If that changes, we will update this page before adding them.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: Pujo Pandal does not set cookies of its own. Local storage is used only for your saved pandals.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The site is a general festival guide and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: Your rights and contact
paragraphs: You can ask us to delete any email you have sent us. Write to pujopandal@gmail.com and we will reply as soon as we can. This policy follows India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaTitle: Terms of Use – Pujo Pandal, Siliguri Durga Puja Guide
terms.description: Terms for using Pujo Pandal, the free Siliguri Durga Puja 2026 pandal map and route guide at durgapujapandal.site.
terms.intro: By using Pujo Pandal (durgapujapandal.site) you agree to these terms. They are short because the service is simple and free.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Pujo Pandal is a free, independent guide to Durga Puja pandals, festival dates and pandal-hopping routes in Siliguri, West Bengal. It is provided for personal, non-commercial use.

sections.heading: Information can change
paragraphs: Pandal venues, themes, timings, parking and road access are gathered from committees, local sources and our own checks, but they can change at short notice during the festival. Routes and travel times are estimates.

Always follow instructions from the police, traffic marshals and puja volunteers on the ground. Use the site at your own discretion; we are not responsible for delays, closures or losses that result from relying on it.

sections.heading: Content and photos
paragraphs: The site’s text, design, route planner and pandal data are © Pujo Pandal. You are welcome to link to any page and share it.

Photographs come from Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons licences and remain the work of their photographers; see the Photo credits page. Some listing photos are representative festival images rather than pictures of that specific pandal.

sections.heading: Fair use of the site
paragraphs: Please do not attempt to disrupt the site or scrape it in a way that overloads it. Search engines and AI assistants may read and cite public pages as allowed in robots.txt.

sections.heading: Links to other sites
paragraphs: Links to Google Maps, Wikimedia Commons and other sites are provided for convenience. Their own terms apply.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Questions? Write to pujopandal@gmail.com.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.metaTitle: Disclaimer – Pujo Pandal, Siliguri Durga Puja Guide
disclaimer.description: Pujo Pandal is an independent Siliguri Durga Puja guide. Pandal details, routes and timings are for guidance and may change during the festival.
disclaimer.intro: Pujo Pandal is an independent community guide made in Siliguri. Please read this before relying on the information.

sections.heading: Not an official source
paragraphs: We are not affiliated with the Siliguri Municipal Corporation, Siliguri Metropolitan Police, the Government of West Bengal or any puja committee. Pandal listings and names are used only to help visitors find them.

sections.heading: Accuracy
paragraphs: We check pandal venues and festival dates carefully, but details such as themes, opening times, parking and road closures can change during Pujo. Ritual muhurtas follow the panjika and may differ slightly between pujas.
Pandal scores are Pujo Pandal’s own editorial ratings, offered as a guide to help you plan.

sections.heading: Photos
paragraphs: Photos are openly licensed images from Wikimedia Commons, credited on the Photo credits page. Listing photos may show Durga Puja elsewhere in West Bengal and are representative rather than pictures of the specific pandal.

sections.heading: Safety on Pujo nights
paragraphs: Crowds are heavy from Saptami to Navami. Keep children close, follow police diversions, and use the official helplines in an emergency (112 for all emergencies in India).

sections.heading: Corrections
paragraphs: Spotted a mistake? Email pujopandal@gmail.com with the pandal name and the correct detail, and we will fix it.
